hints.title: Diagonal Invariant
hints.text: Notice that all cells on the same diagonal share the exact same difference between row and column indices.

hints.title: Separating Triangles
hints.text: Diagonals with non-negative row minus column differences belong to the bottom-left half, while negative differences belong to the top-right half.

hints.title: Directional Sorting
hints.text: Sort non-negative diagonals in descending order and negative diagonals in ascending order, then write the elements back.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: dimension of the square matrix grid
complexity.notes: Groups elements along 2n - 1 diagonals and sorts each diagonal independently.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: In-place diagonal bubble swaps take cubic time whereas sorting grouped lists takes n squared log n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map stores grid elements grouped by diagonal index differences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses row minus column index difference to extract and reinsert sorted diagonal streams.
